recipes.name: Fluffy Carrot Muffins with Cream Cheese Frosting

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease the bottoms only of 12 muffin cups, or line with baking cups. Sift together flour, cinnamon, baking soda, baking powder, and salt; set aside.
Beat eggs and sugar until frothy and lightened in color. Stir in oil, vanilla extract, and grated carrot; fold in flour mixture. Pour batter into prepared muffin tins.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove to cool on wire racks.
Meanwhile, prepare frosting by beating cream cheese, butter, vanilla, and confectioners' sugar together until fluffy. Frost the cooled muffins and chill until ready to serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Fluffy Carrot Muffins with Cream Cheese Frosting
raw_recipe.description: These delicious carrot cake muffins with a luscious cream cheese frosting are lightly spiced and bake off fluffy every time!

review.reviewBody: Really nice muffin. Simple and tasty. I replaced all the oil with applesauce. I also substituted some whole wheat flour for the white flour. These are great even without frosting.

This review is just for the muffins. I wanted to cut down the sugar & calories here, so skipped the icing. It was great. I substituted based on what I had on hand or preferences, but this was a great jumping-off point. I used whole wheat pastry flour and brown sugar in 1:1 ratios for all-purpose flour & white sugar. I sifted all the dry ingredients because that's what my mother taught me. I don't know if you have to. I cut the oil to 1/2 cup. I had 3 carrots that I was trying to use up & they yielded 2.5 cups. I use jumbo eggs in my kitchen and used 3. I upped the cinnamon to 2 teaspoons and added 1/2 tsp of ginger & nutmeg as my family really like those warming spices. On top, I added a sprinkle of chopped walnuts as I had some that needed using. This yielded 6 jumbo muffins which I baked in a silicone pan. To make the jumbo muffins have lovely domed tops, I baked @ 425 for 5 minutes, then turned the oven down to 350 for the duration. These popped out perfectly, were wonderfully moist & tasted even better. I would make these again and likely add some ground cloves. I try to balance my husband's sweet tooth with my being a hyper-taster when it comes to sweet things. He thought they could stand more sugar. I thought they were plenty sweet enough between the carrots & the cup of sugar. Your mileage may vary.

Great texture! Wow these turned out really light, nice crumb, great rise - an easy recipe that adapts well. I was looking for an easy & healthy carrot muffin recipe as I've never been able to make a batch that didn't have sunken tops. A few reviews complained about a heavy baking soda taste and although it is perceptible, they were still yummy (maybe shifting dry ingredients together would have fixed this). I liked that the recipe calls for 2 cups of carrots - many use only one grated carrot. As with others, I made substitutions: 2 eggs and 1 tbsp flaxseed with 2 tbsp almond milk to replace third; 1 c whole wheat flour instead of white. 1/3 c oats and 2 tbsp of almond meal (roughly), 3/4 cup sugar and 1/2 of oil, plus added ground ginger, nutmeg & cardamon. Baked for 22 min. Delish with or without icing, bookmarked!

This is the 2nd time I made this recipe. My first attempt was better than the 2nd. Both times I used 1 cup flour + 2 T and 1/4 c quick oats and reduced the sugar just a little. I believe my baking powder was old on the 2nd. My biggest mistake was running out of baking cup liners on attempt 2. I had difficulty getting the muffins out as they are quite delicate and super moist. Also added 1 T of cinnamon by mistake. But they tasted great both times. Not too sweet or too cinnamony and I will make them again. Vanilla flavoured whipped cream cheese is an easy shortcut if you don't feel like making icing. I might try substituting applesauce for some of the oil next time as others have done. I used 3 medium carrots to make 2 cups grated. So 1/4 carrot per muffin - fantastic! Thanks for the recipe and appreciate peoples comments.

This is awesome. Cut back the b soda to 1 tsp, add nutmeg and cloves, sub 1/2 c of applesauce for oil, but put in 1/4 c oil, add in 1/2 c trail mix, and sprinkle some on top. Very similar to the West coast trail muffins at Thrifty Foods - made a doz muffins plus 3

Made this without icing as a muffin and it was really quite nice! I shredded my carrots and then put them through my food processor to get the pieces smaller (mostly for the sake of my 4yo), but it made for a nice even distribution of carrot. I also added a 1/4 tsp nutmeg and about 1/2 cup raisins (coated in the flour mix) since I'm used to raisins in my carrot cake. In the end the family loved them, even my picky kiddo!

I followed the recipe. Some reviews added raisins and walnuts and since we love both I added 1/3 cup hot water softened raisins and 3/4 cup chopped walnuts. This recipe is a keeper. In my family recipe book for sure!!! I share with 22 family members and several friends whom I have served them too. All love them with or without raisins or walnuts and some with frosting. Thank you for such a nice easy recipe.

Mine just came out of the oven. I used unsweetened applesauce as the oil substitute. The only other change was using 1 cup white flour and the 1/3 cup ww and a sprinkling of nutmeg. They looked great coming out of the oven. They rose well and were completely done in 25 min. Though they are moist, and not dense, there still seems like there's a little lacking without the frosting. But once the cream cheese frosting is on, they taste great. I made one batch of 12 regular muffins and then another batch of 12 mini muffins and the batter gave me 8 additional regular size muffins. One batch of frosting covered 12 reg and 12 mini. The 8 remaining I will freeze. Thanks.
Delicious, will definitely make again. Made a few small changes :substituted 1/4 cup applesauce for 1/4 cup of the oil, also only put 1 & 1/4 cup sugar.

These are so good! Definitely a keeper recipe. I do feel that the batter was a little too thin since the muffins overflowed while baking. I will add a little more flour next time. I added about 1/2 cup shredded coconut and about 1/3 cup chopped pecans just because I like them in traditional carrot cake but otherwise followed the recipe exactly. Made them for GET's birthday and he loves them.

Added tablespoon orange zest & cup plumped raisins to batter & used 1/2 mashed banana 1/2 oil - very moist & tasty
Also used orange juice in place of vanilla & extra 1/4 cup cream cheese to make thicker & cheesier icing !!! YUMMMM ??

Have made 2x's and they have not risen either time. I make muffins all the time and never have a problem with them rising. Am I missing something or is this how they are meant to be? Taste is very good.
These were great. They were fluffy and moist but not too sweet.
I would add more cream cheese to make the icing way less sweet. Other than that they were very good and very simple to make.
Delicious! Batter was fairly liquidy.. but muffins baked perfectly! I added a quarter cup of rinsed raisins.. a little shot of sweetness 🙂 Did not make the icing, they are deelish as is!

Yes. I used coconut oil, added extra shredded carrot, whole wheat flour, chopped walnuts. Will use a bit less oil next time. Light and tasty but didn’t raise much. Came out of cupcake pan easy greased with coconut oil. The cream cheese frosting called for butter and I think a lot less or none next time. I used a bit of milk to stir up easier.
I was planning to make these for a friend. I followed the recipe exactly and they came out of the oven flat as a pancake. So disappointed. They went in the trash!

Excellent. I added a little more flour per other reviewer's suggestions. Perfectly flaky, light and moist. Also upped the cinnamon and vanilla extract and cut sugar down to 2/3 cup. While not necessary, the frosting recipe is great also.
Pretty good overall. A little soft but that's how it goes
This is the easiest carrot muffin recipe that I have been using for a while now !
